#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

struct RMQ {
    int size, log;
    vector<vector<int>> sparseTable;

    RMQ(const vector<int>& array) {
        size = array.size();
        log = 32 - __builtin_clz(size);
        sparseTable.assign(log, vector<int>(size));
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            sparseTable[0][i] = array[i];
        }
        for (int i = 1; i < log; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j + (1 << i) <= size; j++) {
                sparseTable[i][j] = min(sparseTable[i - 1][j], sparseTable[i - 1][j + (1 << (i - 1))]);
            }
        }
    }

    int min(int a, int b) {
        int length = b - a + 1;
        int z = 31 - __builtin_clz(length);
        return min(sparseTable[z][a], sparseTable[z][b - (1 << z) + 1]);
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n, k;
    cin >> n >> k;
    vector<vector<int>> segments(k, vector<int>(2));
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        cin >> segments[i][0] >> segments[i][1];
    }
    sort(segments.begin(), segments.end(), [](const vector<int>& a, const vector<int>& b) {
        return a[0] < b[0];
    });
    vector<vector<int>> mergedSegments;
    int idx = 0;
    while (idx < k) {
        int start = segments[idx][0];
        int end = segments[idx][1];
        int j = idx + 1;
        while (j < k && segments[j][0] <= end) {
            end = max(end, segments[j][1]);
            j++;
        }
        mergedSegments.push_back({start, end});
        idx = j;
    }
    k = (int)mergedSegments.size();
    vector<int> lengths(k), deltas(k);
    vector<vector<int>> segs(k, vector<int>(2));
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        segs[i] = mergedSegments[i];
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        lengths[i] = segs[i][1] - segs[i][0];
        if (i < k - 1) {
            deltas[i] = segs[i + 1][0] - segs[i][1];
        } else {
            deltas[i] = 2 * n - segs[i][1];
        }
    }
    vector<vector<vector<int>>> dp(2, vector<vector<int>>(k + 1, vector<int>(2 * n + 1, n)));
    dp[0][k][n] = 0;
    dp[1][k][n] = 0;
    RMQ rmqArr[2] = {RMQ(dp[0][k]), RMQ(dp[1][k])};
    for (int i = k - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= 2 * n; j++) {
            int val0 = (j + lengths[i] + deltas[i] <= 2 * n) ? dp[0][i + 1][j + lengths[i] + deltas[i]] : n;
            int val1 = dp[1][i + 1][j];
            int minVal0 = min(val0, 1 + rmqArr[1].min(j, min(j + lengths[i], 2 * n)));
            dp[0][i][j] = minVal0;
            if (j + deltas[i] <= 2 * n) {
                int candidate1 = 1 + rmqArr[0].min(j + deltas[i], min(j + lengths[i] + deltas[i], 2 * n));
                dp[1][i][j] = min(val1, candidate1);
            } else {
                dp[1][i][j] = val1;
            }
            if (j + deltas[i] <= 2 * n) {
                int candidate2 = 2 + rmqArr[0].min(j + deltas[i], min(j + lengths[i] + deltas[i], 2 * n));
                dp[0][i][j] = min(dp[0][i][j], candidate2);
            }
            int candidate3 = 2 + rmqArr[1].min(j, min(j + lengths[i], 2 * n));
            dp[1][i][j] = min(dp[1][i][j], candidate3);
        }
        rmqArr[0] = RMQ(dp[0][i]);
        rmqArr[1] = RMQ(dp[1][i]);
    }
    int answer = dp[1][0][0];
    if (answer == n) {
        cout << "Hungry\n";
    } else {
        cout << "Full\n" << answer << "\n";
    }
    return 0;
}
